aiThesis.rationale:
**SELL — Fair Value $87.89 vs $218.01 (-59.7%)**

Tower Semiconductor is a high-quality specialty analog and RF foundry — Piotroski 7/9, consistent 14-15% net margins, growing revenues — but the current valuation of PE 112x is a severe misalignment with its actual growth rate and business model. The stock surged +499% in 1 year (likely on the semiconductor AI re-rating wave), but the fundamentals support a foundry valued at 15-25x earnings, not 112x.

The analyst consensus tells the story: 6 analysts have a mean target of $173 — 21% BELOW the current price of $218. Despite listing a 'Strong Buy' recommendation (likely stale), the quantitative targets signal overvaluation. Our DCF base case at 22% CAGR (matching analyst Y1/Y2 trajectory), 15% margins, and 22x exit PE (sector median) produces a present value of $76.87. Even the bull case (30% CAGR, 22% margins, 32x PE) gives only $236.55 — barely above current price.

The SELL at -59.7% reflects primarily the PE compression risk: when the semiconductor re-rating fades, a quality foundry growing 20-25% should trade at 20-25x earnings, not 100x. At $87.89 fair value, TSEM would still command a premium to the foundry sector average — this is not a distressed scenario.
